# Tickets

> Open-source agile ticket tracker built with Laravel. Includes a Kanban board, knowledge base, real-time collaboration, and a REST API.

AI agents can interact with Tickets through its REST API or its MCP server, both using Bearer token authentication.

## MCP Server (preferred for AI assistants)

Model Context Protocol endpoint: `POST /mcp/tickets` with `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN` (same token as the REST API). JSON-RPC with `method: tools/list` or `tools/call`. Local stdio server handle is `tickets` — set `MCP_USER_ID` to the acting user id since there is no HTTP auth layer.

| Tool | Arguments |
|------|-----------|
| `get-lookups-tool` | none — returns statuses, types, importance, active projects, milestones, users with IDs. Call first. |
| `list-tickets-tool` | `status_id`, `unassigned` (bool), `include_pulse` (bool), `per_page` (max 100, default 20). Lists your assigned tickets, newest first. |
| `get-ticket-tool` | `ticket_id` (required) — full detail, visible notes with replies, pulse state. |
| `get-pulse-tool` | `ticket_id` (required) — standalone execution state, blocker, next action, decisions, threads. |
| `create-ticket-tool` | `subject` (required), `type_id`, `importance_id`, `project_id`, `milestone_id` (required); `description`, `status_id`, `due_at` (YYYY-MM-DD), `estimate`, `storypoints`. Assigned to you. |
| `update-ticket-tool` | `ticket_id` (required); `subject`, `description`, `status_id`. Own/assigned only. |
| `add-note-tool` | `ticket_id` (required, must own or be assigned); `body` (slash commands work: `/close`, `/status`, `/hours`, `/blocker`, `/decision`, `/action @user`, `/estimate`); `hours` (max 999); `status_id`; `claim` (bool, self-assign). `/action` requires exactly one @assignee. |
| `reply-to-note-tool` | `ticket_id`, `note_id` (top-level only), `body` (all required). |
| `edit-note-tool` | `ticket_id`, `note_id`, `body` (all required). Own notes only; decisions immutable. |
| `resolve-note-tool` | `ticket_id`, `note_id`, `resolution_message` (all required). Author or assignee only. |
| `react-to-note-tool` | `ticket_id`, `note_id`, `emoji` (thumbsup, eyes). Toggles. |
| `get-kb-lookups-tool` | none — knowledge base categories and tags with IDs. Call first for KB writes. |
| `kb-search-tool` | `query`, `category_id`, `status` (draft/verified/deprecated), `tag_id`, `per_page` (max 100). Keyword search over title/body/tags, scoped to what you can see. |
| `get-kb-article-tool` | `slug` (or numeric id, required) — body, category, tags, status, version count. Visible articles only. |
| `create-kb-article-tool` | `title`, `body_markdown`, `category_id`, `visibility` (public/internal/restricted), `commit_message`, `tags` (≥1) required; `status` optional. You become the owner. |
| `update-kb-article-tool` | `id`, `title`, `body_markdown`, `category_id`, `visibility`, `commit_message`, `tags` (≥1) required; `status` optional. Owner or permitted editor; creates a new version. |

Note: `tools/list` is paginated (15 per page) — follow `nextCursor` for the rest. Full reference: [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/velkymx/tickets/blob/master/docs/mcp.md).

## Base URL

`/api/v1` — All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`

## Authentication

Generate a token from the user profile page (`/user/api-token`). All API requests require the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/health` | Health check — returns `{"status": "ok"}` |
| GET | `/lookups` | Returns statuses, types, importance levels, projects, milestones, releases, and users with IDs |
| GET | `/tickets` | List tickets — supports `status`, `unassigned`, `pulse` query params |
| POST | `/tickets` | Create ticket — requires `subject`; optional `description`, `type_id`, `importance_id`, `project_id`, `milestone_id`, `due_at`, `estimate`, `storypoints` |
| GET | `/tickets/{id}` | Get ticket detail with notes, reactions, replies, attachments |
| POST | `/tickets/{id}/note` | Add note — supports `body`, `status_id`, `hours`, `claim`. Body supports slash commands: `/decision`, `/blocker`, `/action`, `/assign`, `/status`, `/hours`, `/estimate`, `/close`, `/reopen` |
| POST | `/tickets/{id}/notes/{noteId}/reply` | Reply to a note |
| PUT | `/tickets/{id}/notes/{noteId}` | Edit a note |
| POST | `/tickets/{id}/notes/{noteId}/react` | Toggle emoji reaction on a note — pass `emoji` param |
| POST | `/tickets/{id}/notes/{noteId}/resolve` | Resolve a thread — requires `resolution_message` |
| GET | `/tickets/{id}/pulse` | Returns execution state (ON TRACK, AT RISK, BLOCKED, IDLE), latest blocker, next action, latest decision, open threads |

## Key Concepts

- **Lookups first**: Always call `/lookups` to get valid IDs before creating/updating tickets
- **Ticket Pulse**: Real-time execution state. Check pulse before acting — a BLOCKED ticket needs unblocking, not more status updates
- **Slash commands**: Use `/blocker`, `/decision`, `/action` in note body to add structured signals that surface in pulse data

## Web Features (Non-API)

- CSV import: Navigate to `/tickets/import` in the UI — requires existing projects
- Kanban board: `/tickets/board`
- Knowledge base: `/kb`
